[Skip to main content](https://supportgowhere.life.gov.sg/schemes/3KmPKHA7/working-mothers-child-relief-wmcr#main-content) # Working Mother's Child Relief (WMCR) - SupportGoWhere Working Mother's Child Relief (WMCR) Share link Provides tax relief for eligible working mothers, up to 25% of earned income per child. Encourages married women to stay in the workforce after having children, and rewards families with children who are Singapore Citizens. SCHEME HIGHLIGHTS - Relief of up to 25% of working mother’s earned income per child or $12,000 per child - Receive cumulative tax relief for multiple children, up to 100% of your earnable income [Apply now](https://mytax.iras.gov.sg/login/selection) Expand all sections About this support - Up to 25% of the mother's earned income can be claimed as tax relief for each child - Relief amount is cumulative for multiple children, capped at 100% of the mother's earned income - Relief may be claimed alongside the Qualifying Child Relief (QCR) or Child Relief (Disability) on the same child - The total relief cap is $50,000 per child for all 3 combined Who is this for? To be eligible for WMCR, you must fulfil all the following conditions in the previous year : - You are a working mother who is married, divorced or widowed - You have taxable earned income from employment, through pensions, trade or business, or via profession or vocation - You have cared for a child who was a Singapore Citizen as at 31 December of the previous year and qualifies for QCR / Child Relief (Disability) - You may read more on the [QCR and Child Relief (Disability) schemes and their criteria here](https://www.iras.gov.sg/taxes/individual-income-tax/basics-of-individual-income-tax/tax-reliefs-rebates-and-deductions/tax-reliefs/qualifying-child-relief-(qcr)-child-relief-(disability))) - You may still claim WMCR even for children who have passed away in the previous year The amount of WMCR you may claim is based on child order. | Child order | WMCR amount from YA 2025 | | | For a Qualifying Singaporean child born/adopted before 1 Jan 2024 _^_ | For a Qualifying Singaporean
child born/adopted
on or after 1  Jan 2024 | | 1st | 15% of mother's earned income | $8,000 | | 2nd | 20% of mother's earned income | $10,000 | | 3rd and beyond | 25% of mother's earned income | $12,000 | _^ WMCR percentages are added together if you claim for more than one child and the total is capped at 100% of the mother's earned income._ You may claim still WMCR even if you and / or your husband or ex-husband has already claimed the QCR / Child Relief (Disability) schemes on the same child. However, you must note the following conditions: - QCR / Child Relief (Disability) claims must be utilised first (claims may be made by you or your spouse) - The total relief cap (i.e. QCR / Child Relief (Disability) plus WMCR) is $50,000 per child - The WMCR is limited to the remaining balance after the QCR / Child Relief (Disability) claim is allowed How to apply? | **For e-Filing:** | **For paper filing:** | | - If you previously claimed WMCR last year and your circumstances remain unchanged, the relief amount will be pre-filled and automatically granted

- If claiming the relief for the first time:

- Log in to [myTax Portal](https://mytax.iras.gov.sg/login/selection) using your Singpass or [Singpass Foreign user Account (SFA)](https://www.iras.gov.sg/digital-services/others/singpass-foreign-user-account-(sfa)-for-foreign-individuals)

- Navigate to “Individuals” > “File Income Tax Return”

- Select “File” to File Income Tax Return

- Go to “4. Deductions, Tax Reliefs and Rebates”

- Select “Add New” > “Child”

- Fill in the relevant information and select “Yes” under “Claim Working Mother’s Child Relief”

- Select “Update” | - Complete the section on “Child Relief” in Form B1 & B

- If it’s your first time claiming WMCR, indicate 'Y' under the “Claim for WMCR” column and fill in your child's details in Appendix 2 as well | The WMCR amount will be computed and applied automatically based on your eligibility when your Income Tax Return is processed. Where can I find help? [View more details](https://www.iras.gov.sg/taxes/individual-income-tax/basics-of-individual-income-tax/tax-reliefs-rebates-and-deductions/tax-reliefs/working-mother's-child-relief-(wmcr)) * * * IRAS hotline: [1800-356-8300](tel:1800-356-8300) Airtime charges apply for mobile calls to 1800 service lines. Calls are free of charge only if made from regular land lines in Singapore. * * * [Submit an enquiry](https://www.iras.gov.sg/contact-us/individual-income-tax) * * * [Visit your nearest branch](https://www.iras.gov.sg/contact-us/locate-us) Scheme last updated 12 Sep 2025 Try our AI search
